papers.title: HALO: Human-Grounded Granular Evaluation of Proactive Agents
papers.summary: HALO introduces a human-annotated benchmark and dataset to evaluate proactive agents, revealing that over-proactivity is the dominant failure mode.
papers.insight: Novo benchmark ou dataset, um sinal técnico que pode virar produto.

papers.title: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data

papers.title: CaPtain: A Pipeline for Post-Training Code-as-Policy Robot Agents
papers.summary: CaPtain trains small open vision-language models via supervised fine-tuning and multi-turn reinforcement learning with a physical critic to perform robot manipulation through code, achieving strong results without frontier models or vision-language-action backbones.
papers.insight: Vem com código aberto, fácil de experimentar.

papers.title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
papers.summary: Apriel Voice 27B Preview is an open speech-language model that integrates speech understanding, reasoning, and tool use within a shared backbone, achieving strong results on audio benchmarks through a two-stage training procedure with online distillation.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 33 upvotes no Hugging Face.
